_note: Dialogue nodes: speaker, text (max ~140 chars), next, choices[{text,next}], set[flags]. A conversation is the chain starting at the id used in quests.json/npcs.json. Idle lines rotate by time (day|dusk|night) and village level.

pip.s1.speaker: pip
pip.s1.text: Oh! You're the new Keeper! I'm Pip. This is the village. It's... cosy. Dusty, but cosy.

pip.s1b.speaker: pip
pip.s1b.text: See that old lighthouse? The Glimmerlight is dimming and the Glimmers are getting sleepy. We need a Keeper. That's you!

pip.s1c.speaker: pip
pip.s1c.text: Three lenses made the light shine. They got lost where Glimmers like to nap. Nobody is cross. We just need to find them!

pip.s1d.speaker: pip
pip.s1d.text: First, let's make this a home. Come and see me whenever my little ! bounces. I always have a plan. And a clipboard.

pip.s2.speaker: pip
pip.s2.text: Every great village starts with a log. Or six. I'd say six.

pip.s2b.speaker: pip
pip.s2b.text: Hold F, or click, on a tree trunk to chop it. The trees don't mind. Mostly.

pip.s2c.speaker: pip
pip.s2c.text: Anywhere with leaves on top! There's a lovely bunch just past the green.

pip.s3.speaker: pip
pip.s3.text: Logs are lovely, but planks are practical. Press C for the Workbench and make some. It's like baking, but with wood.

pip.s3b.speaker: pip
pip.s3b.text: Planks. Say it with me: planks.

pip.s3c.speaker: pip
pip.s3c.text: Wonderful! You're a natural. Off you go!

pip.s4.speaker: pip
pip.s4.text: Time for a home! Stack 20 blocks right here by the green. This first cottage will be yours, Keeper!

pip.s4b.speaker: pip
pip.s4b.text: Pick a block with 1 to 0, then press X or right-click to place it. I'll supervise. With my clipboard.

pip.s5.speaker: pip
pip.s5.text: What a cosy start! Now the Glimmers. They're shy, but a berry says hello in every language.

pip.s5b.speaker: pip
pip.s5b.text: Find a Puffbun, hold a berry and press E. Walk slowly. Puffbuns are curious, not brave.

bram.s6.speaker: bram
bram.s6.text: Name's Bram. I build things. Mostly walls. Mostly puns about walls. They're load-bearing.

bram.s6b.speaker: bram
bram.s6b.text: Saw your cottage from the road. Not bad! A little... left-leaning. Like me.

bram.s6c.speaker: bram
bram.s6c.text: Heh. When the lenses turn up I'll need 10 cobble for the lens pedestal. No rush. Walls take time.

pip.s7.speaker: pip
pip.s7.text: Glimmers napped on the Ripple Lens by the pond. Your Puffbun knows the way. Follow it!

pip.s7b.speaker: pip
pip.s7b.text: Befriend a Tidler there, with an orange and a splashy game. It will dive for the lens. Dive. Lens. Get it?

pip.s8.speaker: pip
pip.s8.text: Next, the forest! Befriend a Sprigfox, apples are their favourite. They're shy, so walk softly.

pip.s8b.speaker: pip
pip.s8b.text: A good friend can sniff out glowcaps. Follow the glow to an old stump. Something lens-shaped is napping there.

bram.s9.speaker: bram
bram.s9.text: Last lens is up in the highland meadow. Take the north path up the ramp. Follow the sparkly clover.

bram.s9b.speaker: bram
bram.s9b.text: I'd build you a bridge but I'm all out of pun-ctuation. Take your friends. Glimmers love a hike.

bram.s10.speaker: bram
bram.s10.text: Three lenses, one pedestal, zero ceiling leaks. Meet me at the lighthouse and bring 10 cobble.

bram.s10b.speaker: bram
bram.s10b.text: Press E on the pedestal to set the lenses. I'll hold the ladder. Figuratively.

marlo.hello.speaker: marlo
marlo.hello.text: The tide told me you were coming. It also told me to bring snacks.

marlo.hello2.speaker: marlo
marlo.hello2.text: I'm Marlo. I fish, I ferry, I listen to the water. Your Tidler friend splashes like it knows me.

marlo.hello3b.speaker: marlo
marlo.hello3b.text: Only on Tuesdays. Today is... tidal.

marlo.hello3.speaker: marlo
marlo.hello3.text: The cove route will be open for you. Bring oranges. Tidlers go wild for them.

willa.hello.speaker: willa
willa.hello.text: Shh. The berries are shy. So are the foxes. Walk softly.

willa.hello2.speaker: willa
willa.hello2.text: I'm Willa. I grow things and I listen to them. Your Sprigfox is wearing the happiest tail.

willa.hello3b.speaker: willa
willa.hello3b.text: Apples, mostly. And compliments. Sprigfoxes adore compliments.

willa.hello3.speaker: willa
willa.hello3.text: The Whisperwood path is yours now. Tiptoe, and the forest will tell you its secrets.

pip.s11.speaker: pip
pip.s11.text: It's lit! The Glimmerlight is lit! Everybody to the green! There will be snacks. There are always snacks.

pip.s11b.speaker: pip
pip.s11b.text: Well! That's the whole island done. Now it's yours, Keeper. Build, explore, make friends. We'll keep the lamps on.

pip.wish.speaker: pip
pip.wish.text: I wrote you some Village Wishes. Decorate, make friends, fill the Glimmerdex. No rush. We have all the time in the world.

pip.pedestal.nocobble.speaker: bram
pip.pedestal.nocobble.text: The pedestal needs 10 cobble to stay put. Break some stone and press C to make cobble!

pip.pedestal.nolens.speaker: bram
pip.pedestal.nolens.text: Still missing a lens or two. They're napping somewhere: the pond, the forest, the highland.

pip.text: Oh! A visitor! Well, a resident. Same paperwork.
I'm counting the cottages. There are still three. It's going well.
Good morning, Keeper! The Glimmers have been bouncing since sunrise.
Lovely day for a log. Or six. I keep saying that.
The sky looks like orange sherbet. I should write that down.
Shh. The fireflies are signing in. They're very punctual.
The village feels bigger already! Two more neighbours and I'll need a bigger clipboard.
Everyone is here! The village green has never been so loud. I love it.
The Glimmerlight is shining. My clipboard has never been this happy.

bram.text: Measure twice, cut once. Pun twice, regret once.
I just fixed a wall. It was a bit low. Now it's high-spirited.
Morning! Great day to put one block on top of another.
Fun fact: bricks never tell secrets. They're very wall-ed off.
Sunset on a good roof. That's the best view in the world.
Quiet night. Even the hammer is dreaming.
That pedestal's coming along. Stone-cold professional.
Best village I've built in. And the first. And the only. Still best.

marlo.text: The water's whispering again. Something about a sandwich.
Tides come, tides go. Snacks stay.
Today the sea is the colour of a sleepy blue crayon.
A Tidler splashed my boots. I think it was a hello.
Dusk is when the fish tell their best jokes.
Moon on the water. That's the oldest lantern there is.
Everyone's home safe. The tide approves.

willa.text: Berries like to be asked nicely. Please and thank you work on most plants.
The dew is still on the clover. It tastes like the morning, I'm told.
If you see a fox tail wag, say thank you. It's a compliment.
Dusk is when the glowcaps wake up. Tiptoe. They're ticklish.
Goodnight, little flowers. Goodnight, little foxes.
The Glimmerlight is on! Even the moss is dancing.
